skillFull: Leaps up into the air at certain intervals before smashing down and causing an explosion, creating Mudang Jellies and Mudang Potions. Level Up for more points for Mudang Jellies and more Energy recovered from Mudang Potions.
story: Lady Mudang tosses its sturdy body forward, chasing off all kinds of evil spirits. At one point, it even attacked Scallion Kimchi Cookie collapsed upon the ground exhausted after mistaking her for a ghost. From that day on, the two found themselves sticking together. After coming to find great trust and appreciation for Scallion Kimchi Cookie's work as an exorcist, it has now decided to sit back and enjoy its life as an ordinary ladybug, basking in the sunlight and open fields of grass. There's no true end to a real mudang's work, though. Catch the wrong light in Lady Mudang's sharp eyes and you may find yourself on the wrong end of its attacks.

combi.desc: +137,000 pts for Scallion Kimchi Bear Jellies

costumes.name: Jakdu Headbutt
costumes.info: Lady Mudang serves as the spearhead of the procession, leading the way though the ritual site as the shaman possessed with the spirits of Great Generals raises her blades. The Pet flies towards the wicked spirits with the fierce strength of a jakdu, refusing to back down no matter what it may face. If you think you saw it waver getting dizzy after yet another powerful headbutt... maybe the spirits are just making you see things.
